title: Draw It In: node #18's suffix is too weak to beat SDXL's portrait prior, so the subject lands cropped and nothing casts a shadow
description: Root cause found and evidenced under MPI-567, deliberately not fixed there. The render phase's prompt suffix (node #18 `Append Clean Background`) says `full object in frame`, which loses to SDXL's portrait framing prior: a prompt like "a Latina in a red dress at the beach" comes back cropped at the shins, so there is no contact point, so the blend phase's contact shading (#103) has nothing to ground and no shadow appears. Today the user has to know to type "full body far shot" themselves. Strengthen #18 so the flow stops requiring that. Verify on a live run - this is a prompt-behaviour change, not a graph-wiring one.
